contract.printed_heading: HEAR THE ROLE, SING THE NOTE, THEN PLACE IT INSIDE THE CHORD
contract.printed_priority: Guide-tone priority: if response time is slow, practice only thirds and sevenths until they are immediate; roots and fifths are added afterward.

plan_schema.cue_provider: chosen external human, authored manual delivery policy
plan_schema.arrangements: two distinct chosen string sets, chosen target inside each chosen voicing, same chosen pitch class

response_schema.pitch_name: chromatic spelling or null/unknown; attempt singing before choosing arrangements
response_schema.failure: release and diagnosis; retry; never fill unknown learner answers

authored_policies: Source answer retained separately until initial playing/release and explicit reveal; wrong response remains playable beforehand.
Two different chosen string sets form a private representation of the two blank source columns; no printed set membership or voicing is asserted.
Contacts reuse r61 standard-tuning fret0..24 domain; chord correctness is manual, with no source-fixed voicing or automatic chord oracle.
Qualitative slow/uncertain self-report returns printed priority guidance; no numeric timing, score or mastery threshold is invented.
Literal56TONES does not create a four-tone sequence, extra attacks or another string-set stage.
Page13 context-only/no-guitar-root/three-register commands are not imported into page14.

Final official row15 identity and B# / C literal remain exact. Independent source Accept enables the same private manual task; the original visual occlusion remains provenance and source clocks/voicing/contacts remain unknown.
